definitions.explanation: Clothing of Western origin, as opposed to traditional Japanese clothing (wafuku). Includes suits, dresses, shirts, pants, etc.

examples.japanese: {普段|ふだん}は{洋服|ようふく}を{着|き}ています。
{洋服|ようふく}と{和服|わふく}ではお{手入|てい}れの{仕方|しかた}が{違|ちが}います。
examples.english: Western and Japanese clothes require different care.

examples.japanese: {洋服|ようふく}{ダンス|だんす}に{服|ふく}を{掛|か}けました。
examples.english: I hung the clothes in the wardrobe.

notes:
{洋服|ようふく} refers to Western-style clothing.

{洋|よう} = Western/ocean, {服|ふく} = clothes

Includes:
- スーツ (suit)
- ワンピース (dress)
- シャツ (shirt)
- パンツ/ズボン (pants)
- スカート (skirt)
- ジャケット (jacket)
- コート (coat)

Opposite: {和服|わふく} (Japanese clothing)
- {着物|きもの} (kimono)
- {浴衣|ゆかた} (yukata)
- {袴|はかま} (hakama)

Historical note:
- Western clothing became common in Japan from the Meiji era
- Now {洋服|ようふく} is everyday wear, {和服|わふく} is for special occasions

Related:
- {洋服|ようふく}ダンス (wardrobe)
- {洋服|ようふく}{屋|や} (clothing store)
